getting started

Zero to CI in one command

Install DevOpsGen, point it at any Go or Node.js project, and get a full Docker + GitHub Actions + Kubernetes baseline in seconds.

Install

go install (go 1.22+)
go install devopsgen.dev/devopsgen@latest

Or grab a prebuilt binary from the project GitHub releases, or build from source:

from source
git clone https://github.com/Bangkahdev/DevOpsGen.git
cd DevOpsGen
make build

Two ways to run it

  • Interactive: run devopsgen init in a terminal — the wizard detects your stack and interviews you step by step.
  • Headless: pass every required parameter as flags — the process never waits for stdin, which makes it script- and CI-friendly.

Headless quickstart

inside your project
devopsgen init   --stack go   --ci github-actions   --registry ghcr   --image you/myapp   --port 8080

Inside a Go project this writes:

what you get
.github/workflows/ci.yaml   # test, vet, build, docker publish
Kubernetes/deployment.yaml  # non-root, probes, DNS-1053 names
Kubernetes/service.yaml     # cluster service
Kubernetes/ingress.yaml     # optional, needs --ingress
Dockerfile                  # hardened multi-stage build + .dockerignore
Second runs are safe: DevOpsGen refuses to overwrite without --force and exits with code 3 — see the init reference.
